title: Send a thank-you
text: Text someone who helped you once and tell them it mattered. It will probably make their whole day.

title: Real compliment
text: Give one specific compliment today. 'I love how you explain things' beats 'nice job' every time.

title: Hold the door
text: Small courtesies are contagious. Hold a door, let someone merge, or let someone go ahead of you.

title: Check in
text: Message a friend you haven't spoken to in a while with just: 'Thinking of you. How are you really?'

title: Pay it forward
text: Next time you buy coffee, consider covering the next person's. Or just leave a generous tip.

title: Listen fully
text: In your next conversation, put the phone down and listen without planning your reply.

title: Give something away
text: Look around for one thing you no longer use that someone else might love. Pass it along.

title: Leave a good review
text: Write a kind review for a small business or creator you like. It helps more than you'd think.

title: Be gentle with yourself
text: Talk to yourself today the way you'd talk to a good friend having a rough time.

title: Share the credit
text: If something went well recently, name someone who helped make it happen.

title: Offer a hand
text: Ask someone near you, 'Is there anything I can help with?' Then mean it.

title: Say it now
text: If you appreciate someone, don't save it for later. Tell them today.

title: Opposite hand
text: Brush your teeth with your non-dominant hand tomorrow. Notice how awkward and alive it feels.

title: Five new things
text: Tomorrow, try to notice five things you've walked past a hundred times and never really looked at.

title: One new word
text: Learn one new word today and use it in a sentence before bed.

title: Different route
text: Take a different way to somewhere you go often. See what you've been missing.

title: Ask a question
text: Ask someone a question you've always been curious about but never asked.

title: Eat the rainbow
text: Try to eat three different colors of food tomorrow. Bonus points for one you've never tried.

title: Phone-free hour
text: Spend one hour tomorrow without your phone. See what your mind does with the space.

title: Draw something
text: Draw something in front of you for two minutes. It can be terrible. That's the point.

title: Stretch your comfort zone
text: Do one thing tomorrow that's slightly outside your comfort zone. A tiny bit is plenty.

title: Sunrise or sunset
text: Catch one sunrise or sunset this week. Just watch it, with no photo required.

title: Teach something
text: Explain something you know to someone else. Teaching is the fastest way to understand it better.

title: Play a song
text: Listen to an album you haven't heard in years, all the way through.

title: The two-minute rule
text: If a task takes under two minutes, do it right now. It costs less than remembering it.

title: Top three
text: Tonight, write the three things that would make tomorrow a good day. Ignore the rest.

title: Eat the frog
text: Do the thing you're dreading first. The rest of the day will feel lighter.
Every 20 minutes at a screen, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Your eyes will thank you.

title: Just five minutes
text: Can't start? Promise yourself five minutes. Starting is the hard part, and most of the time you'll keep going.

title: One tab
text: Close every browser tab you aren't actively using. A clear screen helps with a clear head.

title: Prep tomorrow
text: Set out your water bottle, clothes, or notes tonight. Morning you will be quietly grateful.

title: Batch the small stuff
text: Group quick tasks like replies, errands and emails into one block instead of scattering them.

title: Take real breaks
text: A real break means standing up, moving, or looking out a window, not switching to another screen.

title: Done beats perfect
text: Finish a rough version first. You can't improve something that doesn't exist yet.

title: Name the next step
text: When a task feels huge, write down only the very next physical action. Then do just that.

title: Protect your peak
text: Notice when in the day your mind is sharpest, and save that time for the hardest work.

title: Make it a good one
text: Why don't scientists trust atoms?

title: Pasta puns
text: What do you call a fake noodle?

title: Award season
text: Why did the scarecrow win an award?
answer: He was outstanding in his field.

title: Cheesy
text: What do you call cheese that isn't yours?

title: Rough day
text: Why did the bicycle fall over?

title: Birds and veggies
text: What's orange and sounds like a parrot?

title: Cold climate
text: How does a penguin build its house?

title: Beach talk
text: What did the ocean say to the beach?

title: Crime scene
text: Why did the coffee file a police report?

title: Soft bite
text: What do you call a bear with no teeth?

title: Buzzworthy
text: Why do bees have sticky hair?

title: Facial hair
text: I used to hate facial hair, but then it grew on me.

title: Blushing
text: Why did the tomato turn red?

title: Cat color
text: What's a cat's favorite color?

title: Riddle me this
text: What has hands but can't clap?

title: Riddle me this
text: What gets wetter the more it dries?

title: Riddle me this
text: What has keys but can't open locks?

title: Riddle me this
text: What can you catch but never throw?

title: Riddle me this
text: The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?

title: Riddle me this
text: What has a head and a tail but no body?

title: Riddle me this
text: What goes up but never comes down?

title: Riddle me this
text: What has many teeth but can't bite?

title: Riddle me this
text: I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?

title: Riddle me this
text: What has one eye but can't see?

title: Riddle me this
text: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?

title: Riddle me this
text: What can fill a room but takes up no space?

title: Sad book
text: Why did the math book look so sad?

title: Dino nap
text: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur?

title: Brave bones
text: Why don't skeletons fight each other?

title: Corner talk
text: What did one wall say to the other?
answer: I'll meet you at the corner.

title: Crumbs
text: Why did the cookie go to the doctor?

title: Magic dog
text: What do you call a dog that does magic tricks?

title: Chilly laptop
text: Why was the computer cold?

title: Serious penguin
text: Picture a very serious penguin in a tiny tuxedo giving a long speech about fish. Hold that thought.

title: Best stick
text: Somewhere right now, a dog is meeting a stick it believes is the greatest stick ever found.

title: Owl parliament
text: A group of owls is called a parliament. Picture them debating snacks.

title: Cat logic
text: Every cat that has ever knocked a glass off a table did it while holding eye contact.

title: Rain boots
text: Somewhere a toddler is wearing rain boots on a sunny day and being completely correct about it.

title: Hot fries
text: Be the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when the fries are still hot.

title: Cotton candy
text: A raccoon washing cotton candy and watching it vanish is the most relatable thing in nature.
